messages:
Evelyn (PM): Quick: we need GA signoff checklist for Feature Falcon. Key buckets: SLA targets, runbooks/docs, oncall coverage, monitoring dashboards, pricing/quota mapping. Proposing: P99 <= 300ms (<=512 tokens), availability >= 99.9%, billing smoke + canary.

Kai (SRE): Clarify scope: SLA applies to hosted default model path only (rwd-v1). Anything else marked as best-effort in docs?

Evelyn (PM): Yes, default path only. We'll list other variants as "best-effort" in the GA doc.

Ravi (Eng): Canary is green in staging. I'll add a 30-min prod canary job and a short runbook smoke step. Need SRE to confirm alert thresholds and initial oncall owners for 72h.

Kai (SRE): Proposed alerts:
- perf.p99 > 300ms for 5m -> Sev2
- errors > 1% for 5m -> Sev1
- availability < 99.9% for 15m -> Exec page
I'll take primary for first 72h with Ravi as secondary.

Amira (FinOps): Billing: need quota to rate-card mapping for pilot customers and an automated billing smoke (create org, emit invoice). I can run the test if someone provides a test org token.

Ravi (Eng): I'll drop this smoke snippet into runbook:
```bash
# basic smoke - generation
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-v1","input":"ping"}' | jq .status
```
I'll run it against canary and prod post-deploy.

Kai (SRE): I'll validate alerts during the canary window and flip them to prod if stable. Confirm handover: platform oncall takes over after 2 weeks.

Evelyn (PM): Owners for signoff doc:
- SLA + exec acceptance: Evelyn
- Alerts + oncall rota: Kai
- Canary + runbook + docs blurb: Ravi
- Billing smoke + quotas: Amira
Please :thumbsup: if agreed. No objections by 17:30 PT -> proceed with launch tomorrow.

Amira (FinOps): :thumbsup: will post invoice event sample and webhook JSON in 90m.

Ravi (Eng): :thumbsup: ETA for docs blurb 4h.

Kai (SRE): :thumbsup: will schedule the 30-min watch window.

DeployBot: Deploy window is reserved: 2025-03-28 02:00-03:00 UTC. Runbook link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/feature-falcon

Evelyn (PM): Thanks everyone  I'll produce the final signoff doc and ping execs once billing + canary pass.
